    Oops! All Spells is a deck that runs only MDFC lands in order to have 1-card combos with Balustrade Spy, Hermit Druid, and Undercity Informer to put the deck into the graveyard. This deck wins by reanimating Necrotic Ooze after the deck is in the graveyard and winning through multiple possible win lines, usually involving infinite mana.

    • Kefka, The Fool
    BREW
    • Kefka, Ruler of Ruin
      •
    • Kefka, Court Mage
      •
    A midrange deck that aims to disrupt opponents' hands before it wins with Thoracle Consultation or Underworld Breach Lines. While not as fast as Rogsi, the deck runs classic Grixis staples, which lets it attempt fast turbo wins, but it also has the backup plan of landing its commander around turn 3 and grinding out opponents. Most notably, Kefka's forced discard helps to mitigate the overwhelming advantage of opposing Rhystic Studies and Mystic Remoras and provides free info on opposing hands as opponents coordinate their discards.
    2026-08-19
  • Oswald Turbo Stax
    Mono White Discord
    • Strange Machines
    • Fancy a Fiddle
    BREW
    • Oswald Fiddlebender
      •
    Oswald Fiddlebender is a proactive toolbox deck that uses the commander to tutor up a win on turns 3 or 4. After dumping the artifacts out of your hand early in the game, Oswald give you access to nearly every card in your deck without having to cast them. This enables consistent comboing, focused mainly on Marvin, Murderous Mimic and Pili-Pala, and offers a near unparalleled parity break on heavy hitting stax pieces such as trinisphere. Oswald suffers from being mono-white, and from being commander-centric, but is otherwise difficult to interact with, and can threaten wins every turn.
    2026-08-19
